locked_conventions.source_interval: [-lambda,lambda] with Lebesgue measure and zero extension; physical measure is du/u on [lambda^(-1),lambda]
locked_conventions.fourier_sign: fhat(t)=integral f(y)*exp(-i*t*y)dy with Plancherel measure dt/(2*pi)
locked_conventions.prime_endpoint: every prime power n<=lambda^2 is retained
locked_conventions.inversion: Jg(u)=g(u^(-1)); in logarithmic coordinates J is reflection
locked_conventions.source_normalization: zero-Lebesgue-integral prolate sources retain their full source Gram; it is never replaced by the identity
locked_conventions.matched_schedule: lambda=p/2 for odd p>=5 and N=m=ceil(lambda^2)=(p^2+3)/4
locked_conventions.strict_buffer: q=ceil((2/pi^2)*log(50*p^2+25)*log(20)), n_star=p^2+6+q, and targets satisfy t<n_star
locked_conventions.moment_sign: centered even moments are formed from the complete signed Hermitian matrix; absolute prime moments do not determine the source minus sign
locked_conventions.odd_pole: p_minus(x)=sinh(x/2) remains a negative odd-sector feature unless its projected direction is explicitly captured
locked_conventions.strictness: a zero coframe minor, a nonpositive lower floor, or equality in a strict angle reserve is rejected
locked_conventions.artifact_scope: exact theorem regressions and outward source-formula intervals, not physical prolate-Weil matrices or an asymptotic schedule certificate
locked_conventions.arithmetic: finite fixtures use exact reduced rationals; logarithms, pi, square roots, and pole thresholds use outward mpmath.iv intervals; binary64 JSON numbers are forbidden

locked_formulas.source_gram_frame: for C with B=C^*C and W=T*C, T*P_(ran C)*T^*=W*B^dagger*W^*
locked_formulas.normalized_minor: with Wtilde=R^(-1/2)*W*D^(dagger/2), Delta_J^2=abs(det(Wtilde_J))^2 and U>=norm(R^(-1/2)*W*D^dagger*W^*R^(-1/2)), the relative floor is at least Delta_J^2/U^(N-1); U=1 is always valid
